name: sortable-list
title: Sortable list
summary: Rows put in order by dragging a handle or the whole row, or from the keyboard: Space picks up, the arrows move, Space drops, each step read aloud. The lifted row follows the pointer exactly, the others make room on a spring, and a list in a scroll box scrolls at its edges.
blurb: Rows put in order by drag or keyboard, each step read aloud.
